name: Ichimiya Kazumi
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c1707]Kouichi[/url]'s cousin, the oldest of the three Ichimiya sisters. She hopes to reconcile the fighting of the other two sisters. Kazumi is the owner and manager of Cafe Moon Rabbits, located between the two schools. She loves forcing other people to cosplay.

[summarized from [url=http://www.web-giga.com/raspberry/#char]official site[/url]]
